cells.gaps: The ministry put the register at 9,010,181 people in July 2025 (GIN-009) and the elections director at nearly 10 million in December 2025 (GIN-011), but the texts constituting it were in draft in January 2026 (GIN-003), and in July 2026 the director said the civil status digitisation then launched will set it up (GIN-010), with its extension launched in September 2026 (GIN-001); no source says it is in service. Nothing says births or deaths are entered in it, or that other systems take records from it.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-08: the December 2025 count of nearly 10 million is a census figure, and the newest source, of July 2026, still describes the register as being set up, so stage 2. Stage 3 needs the register in service.
